description: Counter-examples X1 to X12 of change masking-sums (R-144), shared by every suite that masks cells at a raised threshold. Synthetic only: invented teams A to G, invented identifiers, no real count. A case gives the cells as the views publish them before the masking rules of this change (a null is a hidden cell), and the cells expected to be masked once every rule is applied. Only the columns listed in `cells` are judged. `related` holds the other views the rule between views reads (D5). Each case is played by every suite named in `players`; a case ignored by a listed player is a failure, never a skip. Cases X26a to X26f (change masking-sums, D17, relation T3) add teams A to E in the quarter starting 2026-04-01; the TypeScript player plays the cases of the views it ports and checks that the others are refused.

kinds.masquer_vue: Apply masquer_vue(view, columns, rows, threshold, liees=related) and compare the set of [row index, column] pairs of `cells` whose structured cell is masked with `masked`. A masked cell carries the reason under_threshold and the threshold. `regression` true: already correct before this change, kept as a regression case. `witness` true: format witness, every expected masked cell is already null in the input, so the case proves the format and no rule.
kinds.echantillon_h1: Same as masquer_vue (the masked pairs are compared the same way), and in addition the sample size of H1 of row `sampleSize.row` is computed from the shown cells only by the pure function of the player (Python `taille_echantillon_h1`, TypeScript `tailleEchantillonH1`) and compared with `sampleSize.lead` and `sampleSize.cycle` (an integer, or null for no size: the verdict is insufficient sample). Added by task 22.1 of masking-sums (D16, R-20261106-18).
